audit.whatIsWrong: The chart said Pantheon, Skill, Tryndamere, Tryndamere, Pantheon while the whys on the same page said even, Pantheon, Pantheon, Pantheon, even — the two halves of one row disagreed on four of seven levels. The header also read 'FAV' beside a 7.5/10 difficulty and a 'Tricky matchup' footer.
audit.why: Pantheon's kit is complete at 2-4 and Tryndamere's is not: Comet Spear at 575, Shield Vault dashing 600 with a stun and an auto reset, Mortal Will empowering every few actions. Tryndamere owns the item rows.
audit.corrected: Skill, Pantheon, Pantheon, Pantheon, Skill, Tryndamere, Tryndamere with ratings 5,3,3,3,5,7,7 in matched pairs; difficulty set to EVEN 6/10 so the three header fields agree with each other and with a 53.09% win rate.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] described 'Level 5' while sitting in the Level 6 row, and no cooldowns were given for the two ultimates.
audit.why: Row 4 is the Level 6 row. Undying Rage is 120/100/80s with no cost; Grand Starfall is 180/165/150s at 5500 range, which is a map tool rather than a lane one.
audit.corrected: whys[4] re-pointed at level 6 and both ultimate cooldowns written into the level-6 phase and spikes[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: Aegis Assault never appeared anywhere on the page, Mocking Shout appeared in neither layer, and dontsFull[1] warned about a 'W execute' Pantheon does not have.
audit.why: Aegis Assault (22/21/20/19/18s) makes him invulnerable to damage from the front while he channels — against a champion whose entire damage is auto-attacks, that is the single most important button in the matchup, and the page told the player nothing about it. Riot's W text is a dash, damage and a stun, with no execute. Mocking Shout (850 range, 14s) cuts the attack damage of nearby champions and only slows enemies whose backs are turned, so walk away facing him.
audit.corrected: Aegis Assault written into spikes[0], phases[3].why and dontsFull[1]; Mocking Shout's AD cut added to spikes[0]; the invented execute removed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Shield Vault's auto-attack reset was never named as the tell.
audit.why: listed in missingInteractions and confirmed by the kit's autoReset flag — the wind-up, not the cast, is when you step back.

edits.before: Pantheon owns this window: his Q Comet Spear poke chunks you from range, his W Shield Vault stun sets up a full combo, and his passive Mortal Will empowers his Q or E for a big spike every few abilities. Don't walk into Q range at low HP, respect the W stun as his all-in starter, and farm defensively — every trade he initiates with W plus empowered Q beats you before your crit online.
edits.after: Pantheon owns this window: Comet Spear (Q) chunks you from 575, Shield Vault (W) dashes 600 and stuns on 13-9s, and Mortal Will empowers his next spell every few actions. Aegis Assault leaves him invulnerable from the front, so autoing into it is wasted damage — step around it or wait its 22-18s out. Mocking Shout cuts his attack damage for 14s, and that is the half of his combo you can actually blunt.

edits.before: R Undying Rage is your equaliser — his combo can no longer execute you, so bait the W Shield Vault stun, survive with R if it lands, and Q Bloodlust the crit heal to turn. His burst is front-loaded, so once your ult negates it the kill pressure flips to you.
edits.after: R Undying Rage is your equaliser on 120/100/80s — bait the Shield Vault stun, ride it out, then Bloodlust back to full and turn. His burst is front-loaded, so once your ult absorbs it the kill pressure flips; Grand Starfall is aimed at the map, not at you.

notes: Three header fields disagreed before this pass: diff 'FAV', diffRating 7.5/10 (a hard number) and a footer reading 'Tricky matchup'. I set all three to EVEN / 6/10, which matches the 53.09% win rate over 1149 games. The largest single gap was Aegis Assault being absent from the entire page — for an auto-attack champion, 'invulnerable to damage from the front' is the matchup, and a player following the old page would have spent a full crit window hitting a shield.
